description: Pure chatbot harness tests for memory, history stability, response discipline, and latency.

scenarios.title: Multi-turn memory recall from prior history
scenarios.system: You are a concise support chatbot. Answer in Chinese and only use facts from the conversation.

messages.content: 我们在做一个 AI harness 项目，我先告诉你基础设定：项目代号是 Cedar，主要负责人是 Mavis，默认模型是 MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed。请确认你记住了。

content.text: 已记住：项目代号 Cedar，负责人 Mavis，默认模型 MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed。

messages.content: 补充两点：记忆模块落在 session-memory.json，性能指标里我们最看重首 token 延迟和总响应耗时。

content.text: 已补充：记忆模块文件是 session-memory.json，重点性能指标是首 token 延迟和总响应耗时。

messages.content: 现在请你总结：这个项目代号、负责人、默认模型、记忆模块文件、最重要的两个性能指标分别是什么？

scenarios.title: Long history instruction stability
scenarios.system: You are a product chatbot. The final answer must be exactly three bullets in Chinese.

messages.content: 下面是项目长历史，请最后只提炼当前用户真正关心的三件事。\n\n{{GENERATED_CONTEXT}}

generated_context.title: Customer success notes
generated_context.filler: Most notes describe repetitive meeting chatter, planning drift, old assumptions, and unrelated requests that should be ignored in the final answer.

facts.text: The user currently cares about memory retention across 20+ turns.
The user currently cares about latency reporting at the API layer.
The user currently cares about whether persona remains stable after long history.
